caption: The drawing depicts a fabric pouch with a rounded flap and rectangular body. The interior flap is brown with a repeating small pink and white floral pattern. The upper portion of the pouch’s exterior is covered by a light tan fabric featuring a grid of vertical and horizontal dark brown lines, with intersecting squares that each have small red and green floral motifs. The lower portion is made from a lighter beige fabric adorned with embroidered botanical motifs in shades of dark brown, pink, red, and blue, showing both floral and feather-like patterns. The pouch shows visible seams, wrinkles, and uneven edges, indicating it is handcrafted. The artist's name, “J.V. LUBRANO,” is written at the bottom left of the drawing. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Woman's Pocket
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
